mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_NAME , U.USER_EMAIL , C.DB_ALIAS , C.DB_TYPE , C.DB_HOST , C.DB_PORT , C.DB_NAME , C.DB_SCHEMA FROM DBF_USER U INNER JOIN DBF_DB_CONFIG C ON U.DB_CONFIG_ID = C.DB_CONFIG_ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM DBF_WORK_CHANGE WHERE WORK_COMPONENT_ID IN (SELECT WC.WORK_COMPONENT_ID FROM DBF_WORK_COMPONENT WC INNER JOIN DBF_WORK_TARGET WT ON WC.WORK_TARGET_ID = WT.WORK_TARGET_ID WHERE WT.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DBF_WORK_TARGET (DB_CONFIG_ID, OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_COMMENT, CHANGE_TYPE, COMPARED_AT) VALUES ( #{dbConfigId}, #{objectType}, #{objectName}, #{objectComment}, #{changeType}, datetime('now', 'localtime') )

INSERT INTO DBF_WORK_COMPONENT (WORK_TARGET_ID, COMPONENT_TYPE, COMPONENT_NAME, COMPONENT_COMMENT, CHANGE_TYPE) VALUES ( #{workTargetId}, #{componentType}, #{componentName}, #{componentComment}, #{changeType} )
INSERT INTO DBF_WORK_CHANGE (WORK_COMPONENT_ID, CHANGE_COLUMN, BEFORE_VALUE, AFTER_VALUE) VALUES ( #{workComponentId}, #{changeColumn}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue} )
mapper.select: SELECT WORK_TARGET_ID AS workTargetId, DB_CONFIG_ID AS dbConfigId, OBJECT_TYPE AS objectType, OBJECT_NAME AS objectName, OBJECT_COMMENT AS objectComment, CHANGE_TYPE AS changeType, COMPARED_AT AS comparedAt FROM DBF_WORK_TARGET WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId} ORDER BY CASE CHANGE_TYPE WHEN 'ADD' THEN 1 WHEN 'MOD' THEN 2 WHEN 'DEL' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END, OBJECT_NAME

SELECT WC.WORK_COMPONENT_ID AS workComponentId, WC.WORK_TARGET_ID AS workTargetId, WC.COMPONENT_TYPE AS componentType, WC.COMPONENT_NAME AS componentName, WC.COMPONENT_COMMENT AS componentComment, WC.CHANGE_TYPE AS changeType FROM DBF_WORK_COMPONENT WC JOIN DBF_WORK_TARGET WT ON WC.WORK_TARGET_ID = WT.WORK_TARGET_ID WHERE WT.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId} ORDER BY WT.OBJECT_NAME, CASE WC.COMPONENT_TYPE WHEN 'TABLE' THEN 1 WHEN 'COLUMN' THEN 2 WHEN 'INDEX' THEN 3 WHEN 'CONSTRAINT' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END, CASE WC.CHANGE_TYPE WHEN 'ADD' THEN 1 WHEN 'MOD' THEN 2 WHEN 'DEL' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END, WC.COMPONENT_NAME

SELECT WCH.WORK_CHANGE_ID AS workChangeId, WCH.WORK_COMPONENT_ID AS workComponentId, WCH.CHANGE_COLUMN AS changeColumn, WCH.BEFORE_VALUE AS beforeValue, WCH.AFTER_VALUE AS afterValue FROM DBF_WORK_CHANGE WCH JOIN DBF_WORK_COMPONENT WC ON WCH.WORK_COMPONENT_ID = WC.WORK_COMPONENT_ID JOIN DBF_WORK_TARGET WT ON WC.WORK_TARGET_ID = WT.WORK_TARGET_ID WHERE WT.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId} ORDER BY WT.OBJECT_NAME, WC.COMPONENT_NAME, WCH.CHANGE_COLUMN
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBF_WORK_TARGET WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}
SELECT WORK_TARGET_ID , DB_CONFIG_ID , OBJECT_TYPE , OBJECT_NAME , OBJECT_COMMENT , CHANGE_TYPE , COMPARED_AT FROM DBF_WORK_TARGET WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}
